little-journeys-to-the-homes-of-the-grea: Elbert Hubbard made his name with these short, lively life stories of famous people, each meant to be read in one sitting. This sixth volume turns to eminent artists — painters and creators whose names filled the galleries of his day. Hubbard writes with warm admiration and plenty of opinion, sketching how each artist lived and worked rather than just listing their paintings.

The ninth volume of Elbert Hubbard's beloved Little Journeys offers more of his brisk, opinionated life stories of famous men and women. Each sketch fits a short sitting, mixing fact with Hubbard's own philosophy of work and character. Readers of the 1900s collected these volumes eagerly, making them one of the era's great popular successes.
